sql:

JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid

  AND td.pref_name = 'Peptidyl‑prolyl cis‑trans isomerase A'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY md.molecule_chembl_id ASC, ass.chembl_id ASC;

up: Retrieve IC50 activity data for the human single‑protein target CHEMBL1949 (Peptidyl‑prolyl cis‑trans isomerase A). Return assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, activity standard type, and pChEMBL value. Include only rows where assay organism is ‘Homo sapiens’, activity standard type is ‘IC50’, activity relation is exactly ‘=’, standard value is not null, standard units are ‘nM’, and pChEMBL value is not null. Order results first by molecule ChEMBL ID (ascending) then by assay ChEMBL ID (ascending). Limit the output to the first 1000 rows.
sql:
WITH target_compounds AS (
  SELECT a.molecule_chembl_id AS chembl_id
  FROM activities a
  JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
  JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
  WHERE td.pref_name = 'Peptidyl-prolyl cis-trans isomerase A'
    AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.standard_relation = '='
    AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
    AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY a.molecule_chembl_id
),
selected_activity AS (
  SELECT a.assay_id,
         a.molecule_chembl_id AS chembl_id,
         a.standard_type,
         a.pchembl_value,
         a.standard_value,
         a.standard_units,
         ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
         cs.canonical_smiles,
         td.target_type,
         td.tax_id
  FROM activities a
  JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
  JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
  JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.chembl_id
  WHERE a.molecule_chembl_id IN (SELECT chembl_id FROM target_compounds)
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
    AND a.standard_relation = '='
    AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
    AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
    AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
    AND td.pref_name = 'Peptidyl-prolyl cis-trans isomerase A'
)
SELECT DISTINCT assay_chembl_id,
       target_type,
       tax_id,
       canonical_smiles,
       chembl_id,
       standard_type,
       pchembl_value
FROM selected_activity
WHERE assay_chembl_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT ass.chembl_id
                           FROM activities a
                           JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
                           JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
                           WHERE td.pref_name = 'Peptidyl-prolyl cis-trans isomerase A'
                             AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
                             AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
                             AND a.standard_relation = '='
                             AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
                             AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
                             AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY chembl_id,
         assay_chembl_id
LIMIT 1000;
